"'''Apexx Awakens / Harvester Madness'''" is the sixth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Three|third season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[December 8]], [[2025]].

==Official description==
''[[Rek Minuu|Rek]] builds a new droid. [[Raxlo]] upgrades his harvester.''
